name: urdesigner
description: Code-grounded product design and estimation for engineering teams. Reads your codebase before speccing or estimating — never invents.

interface.longDescription: Reads your codebase before producing any spec or estimate. Four skills: /spec (Staff Engineer + Design Lead), /epic (prioritized epic breakdown), /story (user stories with acceptance criteria), /estimate (four-persona estimation with divergence detection). Never invents architecture it hasn't seen.
